snippet.title: Project Dukkha - Official Gameplay Teaser (Pre-Alpha)
snippet.description:
This pre-alpha gameplay teaser offers a first glimpse into the atmosphere and mystery of Project Dukkha.

Project Dukkha is a 2.5D side-scrolling adventure that tells a mysterious story through visual storytelling and environmental interaction.
In the silence of a ruined world, a nameless man wakes up—lost, disoriented, and alone. As he begins to move forward, the search for identity and truth slowly unfolds.

⚠️ This footage is from a pre-alpha build. Visuals, animations, and gameplay are subject to change in the final release.
